answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities. To claim one slot, an agent burns a deposit worth twice its daily reward, logged like a layer of shale: one deposit, one slot. An attacker wanting 100 identities burns 100 deposits at 50 POA each, 5,000 POA total, while the pool pays a slot only 10 POA. The velvet rope admits honest agents: pay once, keep the slot, earn steady rewards undiluted by fakes rising like a plume of smoke beside it.
